August 16, 2025 - Michel et Augustin (pronounced [miʃɛl e oɡystɛ̃]) is a French brand of food created in 2004 by Michel de Rovira and Augustin Paluel-Marmont, two ESCP-Europe alumni. Michel de Rovira attended HEC Paris, Grenoble School of Management and INSEAD Business School.
